name: Los Guájares (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of green, white and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Los Guájares (a cross, a flower, a crescent and waves).
history: Municipal flag of Los Guájares; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Los Guájares arms — cross, flower, crescent and waves
